episode_title: Season 3 Ep1 | The New Stars Reality: What the 2027 Star Ratings Mean for Health Plans in 2028
question: What percentage of MAPD contracts earned four-star ratings or higher in the 2027 Star Ratings, and what enrollment does this represent?
transcript_excerpt: About 37% of MAPD contracts earned four-star ratings or higher in 2027, which represents approximately 71% of the current MAPD enrollment. The 2027 ratings published by CMS on October 8 will feed into 2028 quality bonus payments.

episode_title: Season 3 Ep1 | The New Stars Reality: What the 2027 Star Ratings Mean for Health Plans in 2028
question: What 11 measures is CMS removing from future Star Ratings, and what is the stated reason?
transcript_excerpt: CMS has finalized the removal of 11 measures from the future Star Ratings measure set, which CMS described as being more administrative in nature and offering limited meaningful differentiation between plans. The changes are intended to refocus the program on clinical care, outcomes, and patient experience.

episode_title: Season 3 Ep1 | The New Stars Reality: What the 2027 Star Ratings Mean for Health Plans in 2028
question: What percentage of Humana MA membership is enrolled in plans rated four stars or higher for 2027?
transcript_excerpt: Humana reported that approximately 95% of its MA membership would be enrolled in plans rated four stars or higher in 2027. This result caused the stock to jump sharply after the ratings became public because investors understood the implications for future bonus economics.

episode_title: Season 3 Ep1 | The New Stars Reality: What the 2027 Star Ratings Mean for Health Plans in 2028
question: What are the three key shifts health plans must make based on the 2027 Star Ratings environment?
transcript_excerpt: First, star strategies must move from score management to performance system management. Second, the center of gravity is moving closer to clinical execution and outcomes, requiring stronger connections between payer strategy and actual member-provider interactions. Third, Stars must be treated as an enterprise risk because the economic consequences of quality performance now extend far beyond the quality department.

episode_title: Season 3 Ep1 | The New Stars Reality: What the 2027 Star Ratings Mean for Health Plans in 2028
question: How does latency in responding to performance changes affect Star Ratings outcomes according to the 2027 environment?
transcript_excerpt: Latency—the time between learning something and acting on it—will become increasingly punitive in the next era of Stars. Two organizations identifying the same problem may respond differently: one in two weeks versus another spending two months validating and socializing the insight. This difference in execution speed, not just performance insight, will become one of the most important competitive differences between plans.
